testcase.name: Scenario: Search while the drawing browser floats: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-workspace-layout-source/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:333:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Search while the drawing browser floats ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with browser entries ✔ And the drawing browser floats over the drawing sheet ✔ When the user opens the floating browser search field ✔ And the user enters "zzq-nomatch" ✔ Then the floating browser displays a no-results message instead of its tree ✔ And the drawing sheet remains visible behind the browser ✔ When the user clears the search text ✔ Then the unfiltered drawing browser tree is displayed in the floating panel ✔ When the user closes the empty search field ✔ Then the search field is hidden ✔ And the browser remains floating over the sheet
